description: Run the full FreeSurfer cortical reconstruction (recon-all -all) on one T1-weighted scan: surfaces, cortical parcellations, subcortical segmentation and their stats. A batch job of several hours. The step's output directory is the SUBJECTS_DIR and holds one subject folder named by the subject input.

subject.description: Subject id: the folder name under the SUBJECTS_DIR, e.g. sub-01.

threads.description: OpenMP threads (-openmp); hemispheres also run in parallel (-parallel).

license.description: FreeSurfer license.txt, set as FS_LICENSE. Leave unset when the install or the environment already provides one.

subjects_dir.description: FreeSurfer SUBJECTS_DIR holding <subject>/ (mri, surf, label, stats, scripts).

requirements: FreeSurfer 7 or newer with a license (FREESURFER_HOME/license.txt, FS_LICENSE, or the license input); FREESURFER_HOME is set from the executable found
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs recon-all -i <t1> -s <subject> -sd <output dir> -all -parallel -openmp <threads> through the shared native CLI adapter.

probe.advice: Install FreeSurfer 7 or newer (https://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/fswiki/DownloadAndInstall), or set FREESURFER_RECON_ALL to its bin/recon-all.

useWhen: Get FreeSurfer surfaces, cortical thickness and parcellations, and aseg/aparc stats for one T1-weighted scan.
Unattended batch processing on a workstation or compute node, where a run of several hours is acceptable.

avoidWhen.when: You only need subcortical structure volumes in minutes.

preconditions: FreeSurfer 7 or newer under /Applications/freesurfer or /usr/local/freesurfer, on PATH, or via FREESURFER_RECON_ALL.
A FreeSurfer license: in FREESURFER_HOME, in FS_LICENSE, or given as the license input.
t1 is a T1-weighted image of about 1 mm.
effects: Writes <output dir>/<subject>/ with mri, surf, label, stats and scripts (recon-all.log), and an fsaverage link in the output dir.

failures.meaning: No FreeSurfer install with recon-all was found.
failures.remedy: Install FreeSurfer, or set FREESURFER_RECON_ALL to its bin/recon-all.
Read <output dir>/<subject>/scripts/recon-all.log; a license error means set the license input.
